tweets.text: The iPhone Duo is the best iPad Apple’s ever made.

Is there a thinker behind the thought?

Is there a doer behind the deed?

Is there an observer behind the observation?

These ridiculous articles about Jensen being a tough boss make me optimistic that he will be back soon. Especially given the NYT and FT articles about how the US Government approved their China sales. What are we even talking about?

I will also say that in @atreidesmgmt venture practice we have invested in companies that successfully recruited good people out of almost every major semiconductor company, but we essentially never see good people leave Nvidia. This is the ultimate testament to Jensen as a CEO along with the quantitative Glassdoor data.

Obviously the negative articles about Jensen’s family are in incredibly poor taste and a deeply negative reflection on what seems like an organized effort to prevent Jensen’s return.

Whoever is leaking this stuff to the press is helping Jensen with shareholders. Just terrible judgment.

Also funny that immediately after the Nvidia call where they said they were not considering reinstating Jensen as CEO that Semafor ran an article about how a faction of the board wanted him back.

If you are at Nvidia, I think the odds are growing by the day that Jensen is back sooner rather than later.

There is real fear that Nvidia might pull back on their investments and backstops. 
 
I believe this is misplaced. Nvidia’s competitors are eager to take their place, disrupt their relationships and fill any vacuum left by Nvidia.
 
There are at least three companies aggressively vying to be the new “Central Bank” of AI.
 
Across many @atreidesmgmt venture portfolio companies we are seeing Nvidia’s semiconductor and hyperscale competitors trying to lean in and displace Nvidia in important relationships. Ironically, sometimes at more favorable terms than those offered by Nvidia.
 
And of course, also beginning to see the first signs of Nvidia waking up to this risk and addressing it. Their strategic imperatives have not changed and their strategy was sound, but there is only one Jensen and competitors are now attempting to really take advantage of his absence. No one wants a monopsony at the lab layer.
 
I suspect the same thing is happening in the supply chain. But again, there is only one Jensen.
